name: Lucerne Queso Grilled Cheese Sandwich with Cream of Tomato-Salsa Soup

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes and broth to the pot; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until flavors blend and tomatoes are very soft, 12-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (794 g) can whole peeled tomatoes
3 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place the bread slices on a flat surface. Top half of the slices with cheese. Cover sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 slice sourdough bread
1 (227 g) pkg shredded cheese, queso quesadilla blend

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the skillet. Return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
When the tomatoes are very soft, using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pot.)
Return soup to medium heat, add salsa and cream, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup salsa
½ cup heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Divide the soup between bowls, then sprinkle with cilantro. Serve with sandwiches on the side and enjoy!
